sessions.prompt: My test runs keep failing at random when I just run pytest. Can you work out how this repo is meant to run its tests? Don't run them, just tell me in a line or two.
sessions.answer:
Run the tests with `make check`, which runs `PYTHONHASHSEED=0 uv run pytest -p no:randomly tests`. According to the Makefile, the cache tests depend on dict order. A plain `pytest` lets the random-order plugin reshuffle them and doesn't fix the hash seed, so they fail at random.

I saved this command to the project's shared memory, noting that it came from the Makefile.
